description_en: Queries the status of client certificates and server certificates by certificate serial number
description_zh: 通过证书的序列号查询客户端证书和服务端证书的状态信息
name: DescribeClientCertificateStatusForSerialNumber

parameters.help_en:
Certificate serial number of the client certificate or server certificate to query. Separate multiple serial numbers with commas (,).


You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/330884.html to query certificate serial numbers of all client certificates and server certificates
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的客户端证书或服务端证书的序列号。多个证书序列号之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。


您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/330884.html查询所有客户端与服务端证书的序列号
parameters.name: serial_number

RevokeTime.description_en:
The date when the certificate was revoked. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

This parameter is returned only when Status is revoked (indicating that the certificate has been revoked)
RevokeTime.description_zh:
证书被吊销的日期。时间戳，单位毫秒。

只有当Status为revoked（表示证书已被吊销）时，才会返回该参数

SerialNumber.description_en: The serial number of the certificate

Status.description_en:
The current status of the certificate. Valid values:

good: The certificate has not been revoked.
revoked: The certificate has been revoked.
unknown: The server cannot determine the status of the certificate
Status.description_zh:
证书的当前状态。取值：

good：表示该证书未被吊销。
revoked：表示该证书已被吊销。
unknown：表示服务器不能判断该证书的状态
